teyvat.name: Teyvat
teyvat.description: Explore an island world of quests, elemental puzzles, and combat. Remember clues, landmarks, and earlier discoveries to unlock new paths and complete distant objectives.
teyvat.alt: Teyvat: an island landscape with grassy slopes, flowering trees, and distant mountain landmarks.

minecraft.name: Minecraft
minecraft.description: Gather resources, craft tools, and progress from basic survival to deep mining and exploration. Remember recipes, routes, and useful procedures across long journeys.
minecraft.scope: Cover: Mine Diamond from Scratch, early Overworld frame, step 1; native 640×360 game capture.
minecraft.alt: Minecraft: a first-person view through a forest, with block terrain, trees, and the survival inventory bar.

mobile-manipulation.name: Mobile manipulation
mobile-manipulation.description: Navigate a kitchen, handle ingredients and tools, and carry out cooking tasks. Remember object locations, recipe instructions, and appliance controls through cleanup.
mobile-manipulation.scope: Cover: PandaOmron lemon-tart run at 05:20; MuJoCo capture cropped to 1152×648.
mobile-manipulation.alt: Mobile manipulation: a PandaOmron robot reaches toward a countertop oven beside cookware and a lemon tart.

wildlands.name: Wildlands
wildlands.description: Explore a changing wilderness, manage supplies, and overcome environmental challenges. Remember landmarks, resources, and past discoveries to plan your next move.
wildlands.alt: Wildlands: forested cliffs, mountain landmarks, and turquoise water viewed from above the valley.

skylands.name: Skylands
skylands.description: Traverse floating islands, surface landscapes, and underground depths. Build crossings, transport cargo, and reuse earlier discoveries to complete journeys across all three layers.
skylands.scope: Cover: Aster Reach introductory construction course, full-size variant, seed 7.
skylands.alt: Skylands: a traveler faces a construction gap between floating islands, framed by golden trees and a ruined arch.
